affiliation: Originally Novioscan BV (Netherlands); acquired by Essity / TENA in 2022

transducer.config: Integrated A-mode array, skin-friendly adhesive patch

application: Pediatric bladder monitoring (filling-level tracking, enuresis / incontinence management)
description: Wearable adhesive ultrasound patch for the lower abdomen using four A-mode transducers to track bladder wall position over time. Originally developed by Novioscan; now sold globally by TENA (Essity) as the SmartCare Bladder Sensor for pediatric bedwetting management.
access_detail: Direct-to-consumer pediatric medical device (CE-marked, FDA-cleared); 14-day trial available

image_attribution.license: All rights reserved (vendor product photo; used with attribution for catalog purposes)

hw.notes: Closed commercial hardware; patented ultrasound patch design.

sw.notes: Closed commercial firmware; companion TENA SmartCare app.

purchase.price_note: Sold direct via bladdersensor.tena.com (EUR region); subscription model for ongoing consumables (adhesives, charging cradle).
